name: ztd
description: Puts Claude Code on the ztd governed path: the ztd Gateway MCP server is the only way to act, and every other tool is denied.

ztd_root.title: ztd root
ztd_root.description: Directory that contains your .ztd/ runtime (where you ran 'ztd gw start' and enrolled). The MCP bridge runs from here.

ztd_binary.title: ztd binary
ztd_binary.description: Path to the ztd binary, or a name on PATH.

app_name.title: Application identity
app_name.description: Enrolled application name the bridge authenticates as ('ztd auth enroll app <name>'). Event receipts record it as spiffe://ztd.local/app/<name>.
